entities.summary: Neil Mallon Bush is an American businessman and investor. He is the fourth of six children of former president George H. W. Bush and Barbara Bush. His five siblings are George W. Bush; the late Pauline Robinson Bush; Jeb Bush; Marvin Bush; and Dorothy Bush Koch.
